---
title: Does Gemma feel the same way in English and Hindi?
author: Hariom Narang
description: Extracting vectors "describing" emotions in an LLM and testing their cross-lingual characteristics.
categories: [AI, Interpretability]
date: 'August 17, 2026'
bibliography: ["./sofroniew2026twheemotion.bib"]
---

Recent research [@sofroniew2026twheemotion] in mechanistic interpretability has found ways to extract approximate mathematical descriptions of emotional states inside a large language model.  

In this article, I'm going to reproduce the first part of their experiment (the most basic one) for Gemma-2 9b model. Our main goal is to extract vectors describing emotions for Gemma by asking it to generate stories in english and analysing the behavior of these vectors on a hindi dataset, and comparing the behavior with the one exhibited in a separate english dataset.
